text:
tay: quick sweep before the cutoff at 3:00pm PT — please confirm your release bundle one-liners follow the template and that your PR has an @owner.

Template (single line):
```
Component: concise change (reason / user impact)
```

Example: `runtime: reduce kv-cache churn (lowers p99 latency for long chats)`

If you haven't added a one-liner to the PR description, drop it now. After cutoff we only take critical fixes. Link: <https://redwood.internal/docs/release-template>

morgan: +1 — will do. PR #4567 needs a wording tweak (was too long). I'll shorten and push in a minute.

rita: Heads-up — there's a potential backport for 1.2.x from #4521. I can own the backport and add the one-liner if we want that shipped.

sam: quick nit on style: use present-tense verbs and avoid vague words like "improve". Prefer `reduce` / `fix` / `add` and include the user-visible impact when possible.

eng-release-bot: reminder: changelog cutoff in 45 minutes. Run `/changelog-lint` to validate entry shape.

luis: ran the lint: two failures — `infra: deadlock mitigation` (missing why) and `api: bump default timeout` (missing impact). I'll push clarifications in both PRs.

morgan: pushed shorter one-liner: `db: reduce duplicate connections (fixes lapack race under high qps)` — can someone review/approve?

tay: thanks — looks good. Also, if you're touching a component tag, please add the new label `changelog-reviewed` to the PR so the release draft picks it up automatically.

rita: added label and backport PR created: #4578. One-liner on backport: `runtime: inline kv key normalization (prevents cache thrash on long sessions)`.

sam: approved #4567 and left a tiny wording suggestion (present tense).

luis: pushed fixes for the two lint failures with explicit impact clauses.

release-manager: noting: after cutoff we'll do a quick import and I'll ping for any blockers. If anyone expects rollback risk, flag it now.

tay: awesome — thanks all. If you can't make the cutoff and it's urgent, DM me. :thumbsup:
